Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 14:24–14:29 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was available with six papers, none meeting the Harness self-evolution criterion in item-level scope review; later additions remain possible. The complete Nov 11 and refreshed Nov 10 boards each contained 39 papers, with two late Nov 10 members. Across sources, 65 new identities (58 papers and seven official articles) received three-round review: six narrowly qualify and 59 are excluded, with no new unresolved scope cases. EmoHarness is assigned to its Nov 10 recommendation date, and RoboScript is assigned to the newly observed Nov 11 recommendation date after rechecking its original evidence; both are reviewed on Nov 12. LASER, SAT, RoboACE, FGSE and NCP enter historical-backlog review under their older source dates, not today’s new-paper count. NCP qualifies only as a control-rule admission framework and negative result: all actual candidates were rejected and the active policy did not change. ReTrace has real repair feedback and reuse, but produces an SOP task program replacing the agent rather than revising its own Harness. Three arXiv searches returned no window records; five RSS feeds returned 54; checks of 13 GitHub repositories found no window releases. S2 citations yielded 318 window records covering 285 identities, with traversal stopped at the time bound before all pages were read; the author source was rate-limited. Uncollected coverage remains unknown. Eighteen retries for nine older externally blocked bodies recovered none. Seventy-four author/comment metadata patches were verified against official sources while preserving scientific fields, first_seen and prior decisions. Version-review work remains individually recorded. Timestamp disagreements for RoboScript and TeX-tainted URL proposals are reported without changing source facts. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection-time status bulletin, with no new papers included today.

daily_editions.summary_en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 08:04–08:10 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready; the API explicitly reported availability through Nov 12. The complete Nov 12 board had 20 papers, including 14 late additions to yesterday’s six-paper snapshot, and Nov 11 had 39. All 59 members were reconciled without shifting recommendation dates. Across sources, 24 new identities were found: 18 arXiv papers, one other paper and five official articles. Three-round review supports one narrow inclusion and 23 exclusions. DeCAF enters historical-backlog review under its Nov 5 publication date, not today’s new-paper count. It uses development-set feedback to revise and retain Harness candidates before held-out evaluation; optimizer repeats are few and costs involve tradeoffs, so strictly cost-matched superiority or self-evolution of the improver is not established. UniCommerce has an official month-level November date only: its exact day and paper body remain unknown, and the S2 Nov 1 value is not treated as verified. Sixty metadata patches were checked against same-version official sources, with four no-change tasks closed; prior scope decisions are retained and rebound. Eighteen version/text tasks were completed; 376 distinct body-comparison tasks remain across the two queues. PLVR v1 receives a primitive-library provenance correction. DiscoveryRSI v1 distinguishes the GPT comparison group from its semantic judge without changing reported numbers. HexaShell v3’s skill-policy branch and counterevidence for its older tool branch are separately recorded while the public v2 snapshot remains intact. Eighteen retries recovered none of nine older externally blocked bodies. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection-time status bulletin, with no new papers included today.

recaps.title_zh: 创刊回顾 · 10 月 14–27 日

items.title: MoFlow: Multi-Objective Agentic Workflow Generation
items.summary_zh: MoFlow 根据实际执行的多目标反馈搜索多 Agent 工作流，修改算子、角色和分支循环，并保留候选前沿供后续偏好选择。开发与留出评测分开，在线搜索和离线复用的证据需要分别理解。
items.summary_en: MoFlow searches multi-agent workflows using multi-objective execution feedback, revising operators, roles and branching or loops while retaining a candidate frontier for later preference selection. Development and held-out evaluation are separated; online search and offline reuse provide distinct evidence.

items.title: Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations: Conserving Authority across Replacement, Forking, and Rollback
items.short_title: Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations
items.summary_zh: 本文研究自修改软件 Agent 在替换、分叉和回滚时的授权继承，并用真实框架适配器检查变异后的权限约束。它属于 Harness 演化安全理论；适配器验证不等于自主开放式进化，本次也未复核形式证明。
items.summary_en: This work studies authorization inheritance when self-modifying software agents replace, fork or roll back, with framework adapters checking authority after mutations. It concerns Harness-evolution safety theory; adapter validation is not autonomous open-ended evolution, and this review does not recertify the formal proofs.

items.title: ST-Bench: A Spatial-Temporal Benchmark for Multi-Agent System Generation on Scientific Research Tasks
items.summary_zh: ST-Bench 包含在开发评分反馈下优化并跨查询复用的多 Agent 工作流，以及未参与优化的测试查询。作为 Harness 专项评测收录，不把其中一次性生成、固定提示或权重训练对照也称为递归改进。
items.summary_en: ST-Bench evaluates multi-agent workflows optimized with development-score feedback and reused across queries, including test queries not used in optimization. It is included as a Harness-focused evaluation; one-shot, fixed-prompt and weight-training baselines are not all recursive improvement methods.

items.title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents
items.summary_zh: Skill-V 根据环境反馈同时训练策略权重和修订外部技能契约，契约包含程序步骤、适用条件和可执行判据。通过回放检查的契约作为新版本供后续任务使用；声明式操作受限，不是任意生成代码，也未证明每条技能的因果效果。
items.summary_en: Skill-V uses environment feedback to train policy weights and revise external skill contracts containing procedures, applicability conditions and executable criteria. Contracts admitted by replay checks become new versions for later tasks; declarative operations are restricted, rather than arbitrary generated code, and each skill’s causal effect is not established.

items.title: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
items.summary_zh: AgentSWE 评测编程 Agent 能否按开发反馈构建可交付的 Agent，包括提示、工具编排、状态管理和输出校验。最终交付快照冻结后再独立测试，可复用策略的证据与普通软件任务产物应区分。
items.summary_en: AgentSWE evaluates whether coding agents can use development feedback to build deployable agents, including prompts, tool orchestration, state management and output checks. Delivered snapshots are frozen for independent testing; reusable-policy evidence is distinguished from ordinary software-task outputs.

items.title: Cortex: Measurement-Gated Evolution and Pruning of Coding-Agent Skills and Rules
items.summary_zh: Cortex 把开发者纠正转成回放任务，用真实执行对照和脚本闸门决定是否保留或删除编码 Agent 的技能与规则。通过的工件进入后续任务的 Harness；主要实验来自合成仓库，真实项目未产生学习，强模型收益和隔离设计也有限制。
items.summary_en: Cortex turns developer corrections into replay tasks, using execution comparisons and scripted gates to retain or prune coding-agent skills and rules. Admitted artifacts enter the Harness used for later tasks; the main experiments use synthetic repositories, with no learning result on a real project and limitations for strong models and isolation.

items.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
items.summary_zh: 开放世界、无真值验证器：任务层用「提出—试探—组合」对比步引导编辑，上层把编辑经验沉淀到持续改进 Harness。
items.summary_en: Open world without a ground-truth verifier: the task level guides edits through “propose–probe–compose” contrastive steps; the upper level distills editing experience into a continually improving harness.

items.title: Reels-RSI: Program-Level Self-Improvement for Code-Rendered Explainer Videos
items.summary_zh: Reels-RSI 将视频制作反馈沉淀为跨作品运行的检查规则和可修订的导演手册，且保留人工应用环节。论文承认首轮评价有位置偏差，后续改写也没有应用；收录的是 Harness 组件机制，不是普遍有效的自进化结论。
items.summary_en: Reels-RSI turns video-production feedback into checks used across productions and a revisable director playbook, retaining a human application step. The paper acknowledges position bias in the initial evaluation and leaves a later rewrite unapplied; inclusion concerns the Harness-component mechanism, not a general claim of successful self-improvement.

items.title: VIEWCRAFT: Evolving What Multimodal Agents See and How They Read It
items.summary_zh: 失败轨迹驱动修订，回放与配对评估决定保留，同 token 预算下仍有优势
items.summary_en: Failure traces drive revisions to evidence interfaces and reading skills; replay and paired evaluation select retained changes, with gains under a matched token budget.

matched_budget.quote: The advantage persists at a matched input-token budget.

items.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
items.summary_zh: 把 Harness 自进化拆成「更新对象」与「提案/准入机制」，给出持续 PAC 学习下的泛化界、保留界与基于新鲜验证数据的准入规则。理论界依赖明确假设。
items.summary_en: Decomposes harness self-evolution into update targets and proposal/admission mechanisms, providing generalization bounds, retention bounds, and admission rules based on fresh validation data under continual PAC learning. The theoretical bounds depend on explicit assumptions.

items.title: Compiling Expert Procedures into Verified Programs: When a Small Model Is Enough
items.short_title: Compiling Expert Procedures into Verified Programs
items.summary_zh: PLVR 搜索外部工具调用控制程序，实际执行候选后依据教师动作距离和训练任务结果选择保留版本，冻结后用于新任务。程序依赖人工种子与前沿模型从教师轨迹生成的原语和规则库。
items.summary_en: PLVR searches external tool-control programs, executes candidates and selects retained versions using teacher-action distance and training-task outcomes before freezing them for new tasks. It uses a handwritten seed and a library of primitives and rules generated by frontier models from teacher traces.

items.title: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
items.summary_zh: CarryOn 根据执行失败修订恢复技能的控制参数和控制流，把通过检查的改动保存为下一版技能库。模型权重固定；论文中的累计失败重试不等同于独立留出集泛化。
items.summary_en: CarryOn revises recovery control parameters and control flow after execution failures, saving admitted changes as the next skill-library version. Model weights remain fixed; cumulative retries of failed episodes do not establish independent held-out generalization.

items.title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents

gate.improved_object_zh: 注入的微技能与工具集

items.summary_zh: 跨任务序列根据经验注入技能、裁剪长期无用工具，作用于 Claude Code/Codex/Copilot CLI
items.summary_en: Across tasks, the controller injects experience-driven micro-skills and removes persistently unused tools for Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot CLI.

cross_model.quote: Across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI

items.title: R$^2$Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
items.summary_zh: 在训练中按反馈共演化编排模型与版本化技能；部署时不携带技能。
items.summary_en: Co-evolves Director weights and versioned skills using execution feedback during training; deployment uses no skills.

items.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
items.summary_zh: H-step 由当前策略分析自身失败并提出 Harness 候选；P-step 在选定 Harness 下做 RL；仍未解决的任务成为下一轮搜索集。
items.summary_en: In the H-step, the current policy analyzes its own failures and proposes harness candidates; in the P-step, it performs RL under the selected harness; still-unsolved tasks become the next round’s search set.

items.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: 每次失败后读日志写或修工具，冻结后在新布局上测试
items.summary_en: After failures, the agent reads logs and writes or repairs perception tools; the tools are frozen before testing on new layouts.

held_out.quote: test them on ten new layouts of the same seed

items.title: IRAH: Hierarchical Agentic Tree Search for Retrieval Pipeline Optimization
items.summary_zh: IRAH 根据真实检索评分反思并变异检索流水线配置，搜索检索器、切分器、重排器的结构和设置。优化查询选出的配置保留用于独立留出查询，不等于整个 Agent 自改代码或同步训练全部模型。
items.summary_en: IRAH reflects on retrieval scores and mutates retrieval-pipeline configurations, searching retriever, chunker and reranker structures and settings. Configurations selected on optimization queries are retained for independent held-out queries; this is not whole-agent self-rewriting or joint training of every model.

items.title: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_zh: IF-MAP 用端到端执行损失选择值得改进的 Agent 节点，再由文本反馈优化器迭代该节点的提示。通过开发集检查的提示被保留用于后续测试，收录范围是反馈驱动的目标选择与提示优化组件。
items.summary_en: IF-MAP uses end-to-end execution loss to prioritize agent nodes, then iterates their prompts through a textual-feedback optimizer. Prompts admitted by development-set checks are retained for later testing; the included scope is feedback-driven target selection and prompt optimization.

items.title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
items.summary_zh: 元 Agent 借共享演化档案双向继承历史 Harness 与模型检查点，用自身拒绝采样轨迹微调，缓解「脑体错配」。
items.summary_en: A meta agent uses a shared evolutionary archive for bidirectional inheritance of historical harnesses and model checkpoints, fine-tuning on its own rejection-sampled trajectories to mitigate “brain–body mismatch.”

items.title: HarnessRL: Co-Evolving Policies with a Just-in-Time Training Harness for Open-Ended RL
items.summary_zh: HarnessRL 在政策权重训练的同时，根据反馈迭代任务采样、rollout 指导和评分标准等外部训练接口。候选经当前冻结政策上的测量后准入并用于后续训练；这种阶段性冻结不代表模型权重始终固定。
items.summary_en: HarnessRL updates external training interfaces for task sampling, rollout guidance and rubrics alongside policy-weight training. Candidates are admitted after measurement against the currently frozen policy and retained for later training; this temporary freeze does not mean model weights remain fixed throughout.

items.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
items.summary_zh: 无标签：用模型生成的测试评价候选，不访问标准答案或官方测试；按性能与成本的不同偏好产出 lite、medium、heavy 三档。
items.summary_en: Label-free: evaluates candidates with model-generated tests, without accessing standard answers or official tests; produces lite, medium, and heavy tiers for different performance–cost preferences.

items.title: Which Agent's Skill Should Change? Group-Relative Credit Assignment for Evolving Multi-Agent Teams
items.summary_zh: 不更新权重，按组内相对比较把团队奖励归因到具体技能再修订
items.summary_en: Relative within-group comparisons attribute team rewards to individual skills for revision without updating model weights.

items.title: Unsupervised Tool Evolution for Coding Agents in Data-Lake Analytics
items.summary_zh: 无标签设置下跨问题演化工具，只保留 Worker 复跑时采用且有证据支持的修改
items.summary_en: Tools evolve across unlabeled problems; changes are retained only when the Worker adopts them on replay and the answer has supporting trajectory evidence.

matched_budget.quote: lifting Sonnet-5 at 15 steps by 9.3 points

items.title: Harness Self-Evolution for Long-Horizon Terminal Agents
items.summary_zh: 针对重复运行时时成时败的任务：结合 Agent 轨迹与运行时内部追踪，用 Harness Handbook 把行为映射到源码，并检索其他框架的实现作参考。
items.summary_en: Targets tasks with inconsistent success across repeated runs: combines agent trajectories and internal runtime traces, maps behavior to source code using a Harness Handbook, and retrieves implementations from other frameworks as references.

items.title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model
items.summary_zh: RL 期间，一个教师生成任务相关的机制级技能，另一个根据反复出现的交互问题演化工具和 hooks；只保留使通过率或可训练率提高且另一指标不降的修改。
items.summary_en: During RL, one teacher generates task-related mechanism-level skills, while another evolves tools and hooks from recurring interaction problems; retains only edits that improve pass rate or trainability without lowering the other metric.

items.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
items.summary_zh: 元 Agent 阅读合成任务上的无成功标签轨迹，写入并修订接口仓库；种群选择按元 Agent 看不到的验证任务决定保留哪些仓库。
items.summary_en: A meta agent reads trajectories without success labels on synthetic tasks, writing and revising interface repositories; population selection retains repositories using validation tasks hidden from the meta agent.

items.title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
items.summary_zh: 固定 VLA 执行器，可编辑 Harness 依执行经验自进化
items.summary_en: The VLM planner evolves its editable Harness from execution experience while the VLA executor remains fixed.

items.title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
items.summary_zh: SCOPE 将自然语言政策编译为外部谓词程序，根据执行跟踪和对抗样例修订抽取器、谓词及组合逻辑，并保留或回退候选。收录其策略执行 Harness 组件，标签池变化不等于模型权重训练。
items.summary_en: SCOPE compiles natural-language policies into external predicate programs, revising extractors, predicates and composition logic using execution traces and adversarial cases while retaining or reverting candidates. The included component is policy-enforcement Harness optimization; changes to a label pool are not model-weight training.

items.title: VibeGame: Prompt-to-Game Development with AI-Native Engine and Self-Evolving Adversarial Agent Team
items.summary_zh: 从已验证项目提炼可复用协作契约供后续开发；自进化仅在经验消融中评估。
items.summary_en: Distills reusable collaboration contracts from validated projects for later development; self-evolution is evaluated separately through an experience-bundle ablation.

items.title: AgentOrch: How Close Can Global Orchestration Come to Step-by-Step Interaction?
items.summary_zh: AgentOrch 的 Replan 分支根据工具执行和控制流反馈重写完整工作流，并固定复用于同一流程的新输入。本次仅收录该工作流改进分支；另行进行的权重训练不能据此称为 Harness 共演化。
items.summary_en: The Replan branch of AgentOrch rewrites complete workflows from tool-execution and control-flow feedback, then reuses them unchanged on new inputs for the same procedure. Only this workflow-improvement branch is included; separate weight training does not establish Harness coevolution.

items.title: CEPO: A General Framework for Improving Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_zh: 用执行反馈分别修订协调者与执行器提示，经验证集选择后用于后续任务。
items.summary_en: Uses execution feedback to revise coordinator and executor prompts separately, selecting prompts on validation tasks for subsequent use.

items.title: Skill^{infty}: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization
items.summary_zh: 元技能用同一流程优化任务技能并优化自身
items.summary_en: A meta-skill uses the same optimization loop to improve task skills and itself.

items.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
items.summary_zh: 按执行反馈修订冻结模型外的协议模块并沿固定能力树继承；评测技能另行准备。
items.summary_en: Revises protocol modules around a frozen model using execution feedback and inherits them along a fixed capability tree; evaluation skills are prepared separately.

items.title: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better
items.summary_zh: 本文把 GEPA 的反思候选提出、执行和验证改为批量处理，持续更新被保留的候选前沿，并在留出任务上测试优化后的提示。属于 Harness 优化器组件改进，不能据此称为改进器自身递归演化。
items.summary_en: This work batches GEPA's reflective proposals, execution and validation, updating a retained candidate frontier and testing optimized prompts on held-out tasks. It improves a Harness-optimization component; it does not demonstrate recursive evolution of the optimizer itself.

items.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
items.summary_zh: 策展任务与轨迹以修订提示和 Harness 代码，迭代保留候选并按验证表现选优。
items.summary_en: Curates tasks and trajectories for feedback-driven prompt and harness-code revisions, carries candidates through iterations, and selects final versions by validation performance.

items.title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
items.summary_zh: 依据执行失败诊断修订存储、检索与上下文设计，经验证择优保留，并冻结设计跨基准复用。
items.summary_en: Revises storage, retrieval, and context designs using execution diagnostics, retains validation improvements, and transfers frozen designs across benchmarks.

items.title: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
items.summary_zh: 依据执行反馈更新团队规则和技能，保留改动供后续团队协作与任务复用。
items.summary_en: Uses execution feedback to revise team rules and procedural skills, retaining updates for subsequent collaboration and tasks.

items.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary_zh: 梳理视频 Harness 演化，并区分产物修复、跨任务保留和改进过程更新。
items.summary_en: Surveys video-harness evolution, separating output repair, retained cross-task changes, and updates to the improvement procedure.

items.title: MetaVul: Agentic Harness Discovery for Vulnerability Detection
items.summary_zh: 用漏洞与修复函数对的反馈修订 Python Harness，保留候选并以冻结版本评测未见数据和模型。
items.summary_en: Refines Python harnesses from vulnerable and patched function feedback, retains candidates, and evaluates frozen harnesses on unseen data and models.

items.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
items.summary_zh: 以执行反馈演化冻结教师的 Harness，再固定该版本生成学生训练轨迹。
items.summary_en: Evolves a frozen teacher’s harness using execution feedback, then reuses the selected version to generate student training trajectories.

items.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
items.summary_zh: 用执行反馈和配对检验演化冻结教师的工具与恢复逻辑，再蒸馏小模型。
items.summary_en: Evolves a frozen teacher’s tools and recovery logic with execution feedback and paired tests, then distills a compact model.

items.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
items.summary_zh: 在仿真中用轨迹反馈修订冻结策略外的控制代码，并在留出任务评估。
items.summary_en: Uses rollout feedback to revise control code around a frozen robotic policy, evaluating retained harnesses on held-out tasks in simulation.

items.title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
items.summary_zh: 用质量与成本反馈筛选 Harness 更新，并保留已完成开发评估的候选供后续优化。
items.summary_en: Uses quality and cost feedback to promote revised harnesses and retains candidates evaluated on development tasks for later optimization.

items.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
items.summary_zh: 将失败轨迹转成操作技能，经独立测试和修订后保留，供后续适用任务复用。
items.summary_en: Turns failed traces into procedural skills, tests and revises them with a separate agent, then retains them for later applicable tasks.

items.title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
items.short_title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
items.summary_zh: 评测编码 Harness 跨任务持续演化中的遗忘，跟踪提示、工具和执行逻辑变化。
items.summary_en: Studies forgetting during continual coding-harness evolution across tasks, tracking changes to prompts, tools, and execution logic.

items.title: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
items.summary_zh: 根据失败反馈修订指令和技能，经过回归检查后合并，供后续任务复用。
items.summary_en: Revises instructions and procedural skills from failure feedback, validates changes for regressions, and merges them for subsequent tasks.

items.title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
items.summary_zh: 按失败原因编辑并保留多种Harness，再用固定变体池辅助策略训练。
items.summary_en: Failure-guided edits create a reusable harness pool, which stays fixed while supporting policy training.

items.title: PyRUA-REAL: Robot Exploration and Adaptive Learning through RSI in the Real World
items.summary_zh: 执行反馈推动机器人技能代码修订与保留，既有技能库可用于新任务。
items.summary_en: Execution feedback revises reusable robot skills, and retained primitives support development on new tasks.

items.title: PromptOps: Iterative Prompt Optimization for LLM-as-a-Judge Systems
items.summary_zh: 依据逐步收到的评分反馈修订评审提示词，验证后的版本用于后续样本；实验反馈仍属理想化设置。
items.summary_en: Observed rating feedback updates judge prompts; validated revisions are reused on later samples under idealized feedback.

items.title: EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments
items.summary_zh: 仅将其中按执行反馈保留的工具与访问接口优化纳入 Harness；普通环境文件重排不计入此范围。
items.summary_en: Only feedback-driven, retained tool and access-interface revisions qualify here as Harness components; ordinary environment restructuring does not.

items.title: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
items.short_title: The Last Mile to the Real World
items.summary_zh: 开发 Agent 根据失败轨迹修订 Harness 控制原语，经测试与开发集检查后保留，供独立任务复用；仅收录其 Harness 原语分支。
items.summary_en: A development agent revises Harness control primitives from failure traces and retains validated primitives after tests and development-set checks for reuse on separate tasks; only the Harness-primitives branch is included.

items.title: Beneath the Surface: What We Overlook When We Talk About Agent Evolution
items.summary_zh: 以冻结模型比较 Harness 演化，分别追踪收益、退化、部署成本和跨基准迁移，并审计候选保留机制。
items.summary_en: Compares Harness evolution with frozen models, tracking gains, regressions, deployment costs, transfer, and candidate retention.

items.title: ReferClaw: Disambiguating User Intent for Egocentric Assistance
items.summary_zh: 交互失败触发可复用澄清技能更新，并在空闲期优化责任模块适配器；变更只影响后续交互。
items.summary_en: Interaction failures update reusable clarification skills, while idle periods train the responsible adapter; updates affect later interactions.

items.title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
items.short_title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
items.summary_zh: 冻结执行模型与底层原语，评测反馈驱动的技能库迭代，区分验证器适配与跨任务迁移。
items.summary_en: Evaluates feedback-driven skill-library revisions with a frozen actor, distinguishing verifier adaptation from cross-task transfer.

items.title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
items.summary_zh: CPU-ARC 将推理步骤实现为可复用的 Python 语义函数。构建器依据执行错误、judge 反馈和检查结果反复修改候选，通过后注册到系统级缓存，供后续推理调用。纳入依据是反馈驱动的可执行组件更新；论文还包含小模型微调实验，不能将整篇概括为权重完全冻结，也不能只凭推理节省断言计入构建成本后的净收益。
items.summary_en: CPU-ARC turns reasoning steps into reusable Python semantic functions. Its builder revises candidates using execution errors, judge feedback, and checks, then registers successful functions in a system-level cache for later inference. The qualifying mechanism is feedback-driven revision of executable components. Separate small-model finetuning experiments mean the whole paper should not be described as weight-frozen, and inference savings alone do not establish net savings after construction costs.

items.title: EmoHarness: Boosting Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Meta-Harness Evolving
items.summary_zh: EmoHarness让Builder依据冻结学生模型的失败轨迹修改提示、配置和受限验证代码，用独立验证集决定是否替换当前Harness，并将采用版本留给后续改进轮。主要收益来自音频证据，演化增量未通过多重比较校正；人工开发曾查看部分评测项，因此不能将全部评测称为从未触碰的留出集。
items.summary_en: EmoHarness uses a Builder to revise prompts, settings and restricted verification code from a frozen student model’s failure traces. A separate validation split decides whether a candidate replaces the current Harness for later rounds. Most gains come from audio evidence, and the incremental evolution gains do not survive multiple-comparison correction. Human developers inspected some evaluation items, so the evaluation is not an untouched holdout.

items.title: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
items.short_title: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
items.summary_zh: RoboScript 在任务学习前把汇集的示范拆为动作片段，将现有接口无法覆盖的缺口交给 coding agent 编写环境技能。独立 driver 回放、检查跨布局复用并复查新增技能的得失，按覆盖反馈迭代后冻结技能库，供后续任务调用。这里仅将可执行工具技能的构建与筛选闭环纳入 Harness；普通 Task Memory 内容更新另计。论文未单独量化技能构建的贡献，部署中遇到失败再持续生成新技能仍是未来工作。
items.summary_en: Before task learning, RoboScript segments the collected demonstrations and asks a coding agent to write environment-specific skills for gaps in the existing action interface. An independent driver replays the skills, checks transfer across layouts, and rechecks gains against regressions. Coverage feedback drives further rounds before the skill library is frozen for later tasks. Inclusion is limited to this executable tool-skill construction and selection loop, separate from ordinary Task Memory content updates. The paper does not isolate the contribution of skill construction, and continual failure-driven skill creation during deployment remains future work.
